title: pm(check-owed-reviews): drop the account bar on L2 seats; independence is per session (ruling A on #33258)
body:
review#2 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mjfxPu5HKjUtuveBR

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed. Ruling-ref: #33258 comment 6917060639. The maintainer chose 「A 按会话,修工具」 on the decision card: 「同账号的审核席可以审本账号的 PR,只要审核会话不是开发会话。规则不动,立卡删掉工具里的账号禁令。今天已出的记录都有效。」

## What is wrong

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/l2-review.md` 〈独立性与边界〉 on `main` says independence is per session: 「记录恒带 `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:` 对,两会话相异;⛔ 不限账号,派发账号亦可坐。」

`scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` still bars an L2 seat on the PR's own account. That bar was written by PR #29967 and outlived the charter rewrite in PR #33938 (card #34007). It prints `barred review#N` (and `unjudged` when the account cannot be read), and PR #34058 added `AREA_LEASE_BAR_NOTE` on top of the superseded wording.

Measured 2026-11-16 (ruling record): 27 PRs owe a contract review, and 14 rows print `barred review#2`. All 14 are driven by this account's lane seat, so the report offers review#1 alone, though review#2 was opened for that load.

## The change (rule text unchanged)

In `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`, remove:
- the account bar and `ownAccountsOf`;
- the `barred` and `unjudged` seat states, and every place the report prints them;
- `AREA_LEASE_BAR_NOTE` and `reportNotes`' area-lease note;
- the self-test cases that pin those.

Keep the session-pair reading (`Implemented-by:` / `Reviewed-by:`). Do not touch any rule text: `l2-review.md` line 20 already says it.

## Business reason

L2 throughput. Every repo:objectstack#1 PR shows only review#1 as eligible while a second L2 seat is idle for it, and seats are taught to ignore a standing `barred` line. After the fix, the report means what it prints.

## Who acts

The `domain:skills` seat, one PR, `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` and its self-test only (`scripts/pm/**` is not a governed path). Dependency: PR #34393 (card #34376) rewrites `takerOf` in the same file and carries the bar forward. Land after it, or ride it if the skills seat prefers. Nearest precedent: PR #34058 (+30/−6 in this file).

## Premise re-check

- `git grep -n "ownAccountsOf\|AREA_LEASE_BAR_NOTE\|'barred'" origin/main -- scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`: non-empty means the bar is still there.
- `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs | grep -c 'barred'`: above 0 while an L2 seat sits on the same account as a lane seat.

## Dedup

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue check-owed-reviews barred` → 4 hits: #34376 (open, routing, not the bar), #34003 (closed, added the area-lease note), #34021 and #34126 (closed, unrelated). `is:issue "check-owed-reviews" account` → 27 hits; none removes the bar.
